description: List swap/bridge order history with pagination; includes single-chain and cross-chain. → tx_list for transfer history.

dst_chain.description: Destination chain ID filter. 0 or omit for all chains

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

src_chain.description: Source chain ID filter (e.g. 1=ETH, 56=BSC). 0 or omit for all chains

name: dex_tx_swap_history_list
